  <li><strong>RBI Liquidity Operations:</strong> The RBI is utilizing longer-dated Variable Rate Reverse Repo (VRRR) auctions to absorb a record liquidity surplus of ₹6.02 lakh crore from the banking system.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxPTTdsNURpTTB6bVZwVm9Ya3BoTFZjYm5sNy1PYWY4bm9pZVA3UTZIUUQxMi1kc0hKTkNsLUJfRHVRWGZRRjZWWHFoa1lYQjJNaDcybUNNSjkwUEFQYlRXNDVrWGlBVko0WDNUeTN1MUVkOHdJdThURWQzS1NHYlZEQkF6ZTRMX0FOTlhLa0h3b1dPRU9XUE1CVjFsVVUzRmpWV1hCN2NzNzdvYkZJc2ZB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Forex Reserves:</strong> India&#x27;s foreign exchange reserves have reached a record high of $740.8 billion, providing support to the rupee.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I12</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>US Debt Concerns:</strong> The surge in US national debt to $40 trillion poses potential risks for Indian markets, specifically regarding rising bond yields, currency volatility, and shifts in capital flows.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Global Inflation Focus:</strong> Investors are closely monitoring upcoming US inflation data, which is expected to provide critical signals regarding the future trajectory of global interest rates.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
</ul>
